about_the_game:
In Poker Warlords, each card dealt spawns a medieval fantasy army! You might get dealt a mighty 10 out of 10 Dragons or you might get a measly 8 out of 24 Footmen. Play traditional poker betting rounds with face-down and face-up cards, then choose which two armies will fight for you in battle. You have to know when to hold 'em and when to fold 'em!

Bet smart, battle hard, then win big! After the final bet the fight begins. Armies clash in fast-paced autobattler combat. No micromanagement—just smart bets, unit counters, and tactical positioning. The last army standing takes the pot.

Poker is a game of deception—and so is war. Read your opponents, raise with confidence, and force them to fold before the battle even starts. But be careful—each unit has strengths and weaknesses. Did they just show Specters, immune to physical damage? You don't have any magic damage, but you raised anyways. You wouldn't be crazy enough to do that... would you?

The rich combat system provides a complementary layer to the poker betting, creating a new experience unlike any other. Each hand creates a new opportunity to flex your strategic muscle and gather all the chips into your stack.

Earn your place on the leaderboard or enjoy casual games with friends. Unlock rare avatars, customize your experience, and enter high-stakes competitions. Poker Warlords is free-to-play and features no pay-to-win mechanics—just skill, strategy, and style.

Built by the developers of BattlePoker, a top-10 StarCraft II arcade game, Poker Warlords brings a fresh, competitive twist to both poker and autobattlers. Years of refinement, an innovative blend of strategy, and a passionate community—this is poker like you’ve never played before.
